programme.title: 2025 Djokovic v Hurkacz
programme.desc: In what was a chance for Novak Djokovic to join Jimmy Connors and Roger Federer in winning a 100th tour-level title, the 38-year-old Serb battled Hubert Hurkacz in the Geneva Open final.

programme.title: 2007 Djokovic v Federer
programme.desc: At the 2007 Canadian Open, Novak Djokovic defeated the world's top three players in successive matches en route to his second Masters title, including victory in the final over Federer.

programme.title: 2009 Djokovic v Monfils
programme.desc: In one of the most dramatic finals Bercy has ever seen, Novak Djokovic and Gael Monfils went toe to toe in a tightly fought, three-set battle for the 2009 Rolex Paris Masters title.

programme.title: Murray's Moments
programme.desc: An extended look at Andy Murray's victory at the 2012 US Open. The Scot beat Novak Djokovic to become the first British man since Fred Perry in 1936 to win a Grand Slam singles title.

programme.title: 2012 Djokovic v Federer
programme.desc: With the 2012 season-ending title on the line at the O2 Arena, two-time defending champion Roger Federer looked to deny world number one Novak Djokovic a second ATP world title.

programme.title: ATP Word Tour 2010: Nadal v Murray
programme.desc: Rafael Nadal's 2010 classic with Andy Murray in the semi-finals of the ATP World Tour Finals.

programme.title: WTA Indian Wells 2026 Review
programme.desc: Enjoy an in-depth review of all the action from the women's main-draw at the 2026 BNP Paribas Open in Indian Wells.

programme.title: WTA Miami 2026 Review
programme.desc: An in-depth review of all the action from the 2026 Miami Open - a WTA 1000 event forming part of the Sunshine Swing.

programme.title: WTA Final: Linz
programme.desc: Closing in on her second title of the year, Mirra Andreeva goes up against returning Linz finalist Anastasia Potapova. Andreeva holds a 2-1 lead in the pair's head-to-head record. (12.04)

programme.title: ATP Final: Bucharest
programme.desc: With Argentina's Mariano Navone set for his third tour-level final appearance, across the net stands Spanish qualifier Daniel Merida in the Bucharest title decider. (05.04)

programme.title: WTA Final: Rouen
programme.desc: A women's singles champion is crowned in the final of WTA Rouen.

programme.title: ATP Final: Houston
programme.desc: Tommy Paul bids to capture the Houston title in his first ATP Tour clay-court final against Roman Andres Burruchaga, the Argentine's first tour-level final on any surface. (05.04)

programme.title: WTA Final: Stuttgart
programme.desc: A women's singles champion is crowned as 2024 champion and top seed Elena Rybakina returns to the Stuttgart final, where she faces world number 12 Karolina Muchova.

programme.title: ATP Final: Marrakech
programme.desc: Rafael Jodar storms his way into the Grand Prix Hassan II final against 36-year-old Marco Trungelliti. Jodar is just the second player born in 2006 to compete in a tour-level final. (05.04)
